perturbed_solution: Completing the square, we add $(12/2)^2=36$ to both sides of the equation to get $x^2+12x+36=109 \Rightarrow (x+12)^2=109$. Taking the square root of both sides, we get $x+12=\sqrt{109}$ (we take the positive square root because we want the positive solution), or $x=\sqrt{109}-11$. Thus, $a=109$ and $b=11$, so $a+b=\boxed{119}$.
